fields.description: Issue dated September 15, 1928 (Vol. 33), edited by Wen R. Phillips. Major editorials discuss skepticism about promised winter horse racing in Miami and the need for legalized, supervised racing without political corruption. Coverage includes a dispute over a Miami ordinance requiring dry cleaners and tailors to post a $3,000 bond, criticism of an overzealous Collier County deputy arresting Miami men for killing an alligator out of season, and an appeal to support the Miami Basketball Club. Additional items include local columns and satire, liquor price notes during Prohibition, letters to the editor, and a public-safety editorial urging protection for nurses after a reported assault following a fraudulent registry call.
